question: __________ wrote the book 'Makers of Modern India'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramchandra Guha**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The book **'Makers of Modern India'** is authored by the renowned **Indian historian** and biographer **Ramchandra Guha**, first published in **2010**.

• The work serves as an **anthology** that profiles **19 influential individuals** who played a pivotal role in the intellectual and political formation of the **Republic of India**.

• It includes detailed profiles and selected writings of leaders such as **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, **Jyotirao Phule**, **G.K. Gokhale**, **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, **Tarabai Shinde**, **B.R. Ambedkar**, and **E.V. Ramaswamy 'Periyar'**.

• The author provides an extensive **introduction** that traces the evolution of **Indian political thought**, emphasizing that **India's democracy** was built on a foundation of diverse and often conflicting ideas rather than a single ideol
